_comment: The gold-standard evaluation set. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: scripts/evaluate_*.py and tests/test_retrieval.py read this file via src/core/gold.py, and tests/test_gold_set.py fails if the human-readable tables in data/README.md drift from it. Edit both together. Rows T1-T13 were written against the synthetic Ch6 starter corpus, T14-T25 against the downloaded study materials (data/SOURCES.md); every row was written before it was measured. Rows with tier heldout-text-2026-10-07 (T26-T33, N17-N20, on four documents no earlier question used) were committed before they were run, to confirm the CPU profile once. Rows with tier heldout-2026-10-07 (I15-I28, N9-N16, and the six images they use that were added the same day) were committed before any retrieval was run on them; they are the only data used to choose between image-gate variants, and all older rows are a regression check.
